title: 温酒斩华雄
prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit IMAGE 1, preserving its landscape 1536x1024 composition, background fortress, dragon, Guan Yu airborne body pose and ornate green clothing, three lower-left observers and gate plaque. IMAGE 2 is ONLY a reference for the recognizable classic Chinese yanyuedao crescent blade silhouette; do not copy its UI, framing or composition.
Three mandatory localized corrections:
1 Guan Yu's mature face and BOTH PUPILS look diagonally DOWN-RIGHT directly toward Hua Xiong's face and the combat, not offscreen. Slightly incline/turn his head to make his focused calm gaze unambiguous. Preserve identity, beard and expression.
2 Completely erase and REBUILD Hua Xiong's ENTIRE upper-body arm anatomy, both shoulders through elbows to wrists and hands as one coherent drawing. Do not layer replacements over the old arms. Exactly TWO ARMS and TWO HANDS, each with an uninterrupted readable shoulder-upperarm-elbow-forearm-wrist-palm chain. Pose both arms up blocking: elbows clearly spread one each side of head, each forearm rising to its own gripping hand. Keep two hands spaced on the SAME brown sword handle BEHIND its guard. Show the two elbow bends and wrists clearly, do not conceal missing joints in hair, armor or cloth. Remove every vestigial old hand, ghost arm, extra skin bulge and sleeve that reads as third arm. Rebuild shoulder armor as needed. Two legs and existing recoiling ground stance preserved. His single thick-backed steel saber has one blade, one guard, one handle, natural two-handed defensive grip.
3 Redesign Guan Yu's physical blade into a TRUE BROAD CRESCENT YANYUEDAO: one narrow socket at the end of a SINGLE STRAIGHT RIGID POLE, a broad FULL CONVEX BELLY in the MIDDLE AND FORWARD blade, clearly distinct curved cutting edge, concave upper/back profile and gracefully upward hooked sharp tip. Full silhouette readable like a moon crescent. NOT a monotonous root-thick-to-tip-thin spear/sword or long pointed leaf. Keep beautiful jade/gold dragon ornament, substantial actual metal. Rigid shaft stays exactly straight through BOTH Guan Yu hands and socket. Adjust the enemy saber position so its metal edge and the crescent belly physically meet at EXACTLY ONE believable load-bearing contact point. A small spark at that actual contact only, no sparks bridging a gap. A powerful DIRECTIONAL green blade-energy sweep follows the broad crescent and the down-right strike, outside its edge; do not use glow to hide metal geometry, hands or contact.
Preserve mythic manga illustration style, depth, dramatic dragon and background, no extra characters, no text additions, no frames, no UI. Prioritize anatomically legible two-arm reconstruction and genuine broad crescent silhouette over preserving any buggy local pixels.

Use case: precise-object-edit. IMAGE 1 is the edit target. Keep 1536x1024 landscape and the established composition precisely. IMAGE 2 is ONLY facial/body identity reference for Liu Bei (slim left man) and Zhang Fei (stocky bearded right man), NOT their clothing.
LOCK all successful foreground corrections: Guan Yu's airborne pose, mature face looking DOWN-RIGHT directly at Hua Xiong, green armor, his two hands on ONE straight rigid shaft and the ONE broad crescent yanyuedao with full forward blade belly; Hua Xiong's NOW CLEAR exactly TWO arms, both elbows visibly spread on opposite sides, both wrists and both hands on a single saber handle. Preserve those two complete shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand chains, no extra arm, no ghost limb. Keep one actual edge-on-edge contact between saber and crescent, small spark only at actual metal contact, directional green slash energy outside the metal so silhouette and contact stay visible.
Change only the following together:
A Reconstruct the dragon's body into ONE anatomically continuous dragon, one head flowing into neck then chest then belly then a single tapering tail. Retain its grand scale, frontal snarling head and action behind Guan Yu. SIMPLIFY its coil into one easy-to-follow sweeping S-curve, fewer overlaps. The neck directly attaches to chest and the chest to belly, all matching diameter and direction. Across any occlusion the center axis clearly continues. Scales on outside bends, coherent belly scutes on inside bends, attached limbs with visible roots. Remove disconnected snake sections, forked bodies, additional tails and all misleading isolated scale chunks. A single continuous substantial GREEN dragon volume, NOT clouds or light pretending to connect broken anatomy. Keep sky/grounded mountain fortress; no floating islands.
B Repaint ONLY the three small lower-left observers as fellow campaign military commanders in high-quality battle armor and war robes, matching this mythic illustration's finish. Liu Bei uses Image 2 LEFT man's refined warm mature face/slim commander build, now ivory-green elegant commander's ARMOR, NOT loose plain civilian robes. Zhang Fei uses Image 2 RIGHT man's dark thick beard fierce broad face and stocky build, now richly designed dark heavy general armor. Cao Cao remains a SEPARATE distinctive seated military commander in navy/dark armor and restrained war robe with a sheathed sword and dignified authority, not a scholar in loose robes, not a fan-holding tea guest, no imperial crown, no pheasant-feather crown. Keep exactly THREE small observers and the warm wine table in lower-left, do not enlarge or move them.
C Restore a clean gate plaque on the center fortress reading exactly Chinese traditional text '汜水關', three clearly legible characters. No other text, no UI, no frame.
Preserve everything else. Maintain strong mythic manga hero styling, clean designed volumes, not realism. Do not change foreground weapon shape, stance or repaired two-arm anatomy while modifying the background and the three small observers.

Precise localized edit of the supplied completed mythic illustration. Keep the entire foreground duel EXACTLY unchanged: Guan Yu's downward-right focused pupils and face, clothes, airborne pose, one straight pole, broad full-bellied crescent blade and physical blade clash; Hua Xiong's exactly two beautifully readable arms with two outward elbows and two hands on the saber grip. Do NOT change a single arm, hand, weapon or face in this duel.
Only finish two background story details: 
(1) Lower left seated Cao Cao in blue military commander's armor and sword must clearly HOLD UP ONE SMALL WARM WINE CUP in one visible hand at chest height while waiting and watching the duel. One simple cup with a fine visible warm steam curl. Preserve his dignity, military costume, own distinct face, other hand naturally near table. Keep Liu Bei and Zhang Fei's current campaign armor and identities, exactly three small observers.
(2) Keep the huge dragon's impressive current head and its neck/chest, but finish the existing long body as one continuous SINGLE tapering tail, not an abruptly truncated thick scaled cylinder next to the blade. Make the body axis readable from head through upper-neck curve across top left, down around behind Guan Yu, then continue its existing lower-right coil into a slender tapering tail curling gently into the open sky behind the blade. A naturally diminishing volume and coherent inside belly scutes. Only one head, one continuous body, one tail, no fork or detached body chunk. Do not use fog/light to hide the joins. Keep same dragon scale and scene, do not add another loop.
Keep earthbound fortress and everything else. Gate plaque should read '汜水關'. No frame, no UI, no other text, landscape 1536x1024.

qa.arms: 3x inspected. Image-left shoulder around (1080,760), upper arm to outer elbow (990,700), forearm up/right to wrist (1070,650), gripping palm (1105,644). Image-right shoulder around (1248,807), upper arm to outer elbow (1330,756), forearm up/left to wrist (1262,708), gripping palm (1223,684). Exactly two visible arms/two gripping hands. No vestigial third hand identified.
qa.blade: Broad forward belly with concave spine and uphooked tip; single straight pole. Steel saber crosses crescent belly at one point near (1020,608). Spark concentrated there; contact not a gap.
qa.gaze: Mature face subtly downturned, pupils aimed down/right toward opponent.
qa.observers: Three campaign-armored men; distinct seated navy Cao Cao holds a wine cup with steam; green Liu Bei and dark Zhang Fei.
qa.dragon: Single head, more continuous large coil and tapering right tail. Some body behind Guan Yu and tail terminal at blade-energy overlap remain occluded. Cannot certify full uninterrupted body exposure.
caveats: Gate plaque still wrong first character, parent overlay 汜水關 required.
Dragon cyan-green hue retained; not strictly pure grass-green.
Dragon claws no longer prominent after simplified coil; tail tip partly overlapped by blade energy.
